subject: CirrusLabs marketplace onboarding: PO flow & onboarding packet
messages:
From: Kate Miller <kate@cirruslabs.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: CirrusLabs marketplace onboarding & PO questions

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking the time earlier on the call. We're ready to start marketplace listings (AWS, Azure, GCP) and want to understand Redwood's procurement onboarding path and how POs map to each marketplace. A few quick questions to help us kick off:

- Do you require a specific PO template or can our standard AP PO be used?
- Which tax / legal forms are mandatory for marketplace activation?
- Is it possible to have different billing paths for AWS vs GCP (e.g., AWS via marketplace chargeback, GCP via direct invoice)?
- Any expected lead time between submitting paperwork and being live on the marketplace?

I've attached our vendor registration form and a draft list of SKUs for review. We may need expedited activation for a pilot customer who is on a tight timeline.

Thanks,
Kate Miller
Head of Finance Ops
CirrusLabs
Attachment: vendor_registration_form.docx (docx)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Kate Miller <kate@cirruslabs.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CirrusLabs marketplace onboarding & PO questions

Hi Kate — thanks for the form and the SKUs. Looping in Vanessa (marketplace ops) and Ben (payables/billing) to cover the routing details. Below is a practical checklist and what we need from CirrusLabs to move to next steps:

1) Legal & tax:
   - Completed W-9 (US entities) or W-8BEN if non-US; signed vendor agreement (we can send via DocuSign).
2) PO and billing:
   - For AWS Marketplace we recommend a PO referencing the AWS listing SKU; AWS charges then flow via the marketplace.
   - For GCP we typically require a direct PO to ap@redwood.ai with a billing alias; we can accept your standard AP PO but please use our PO template for SKU mapping (attached).
3) Marketplace onboarding details:
   - Marketplace listing copy and logo (SVG and PNG), product SKUs CSV (sample attached).
   - Expected lead time: 7-10 business days after paperwork + legal review. Expedited requests can be handled in ~3 business days if all docs are complete.
4) Next actions (what we need from you):
   - Send signed W-9 and completed vendor registration (you already started this).
   - Confirm desired billing path per marketplace (AWS via marketplace / GCP direct invoice / Azure direct or marketplace).

Attachments: redwood_onboarding_checklist.pdf, PO_template_Redwood.xlsx (please fill SKU mapping column)

I'll open a vendor portal entry for CirrusLabs and send a DocuSign packet to formalize terms. Vanessa, Ben — feel free to add anything I missed.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Kate Miller <procurement@cirruslabs.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CirrusLabs marketplace onboarding & PO questions

Jonas — thanks, that checklist is super helpful. Attached: signed W-9, updated SKUs file (includes pilot SKUs we want live asap).

Answers:
- We'll use our standard AP PO but will populate the SKU mapping per your template.
- Billing path: AWS = marketplace (preferred), GCP = direct invoice, Azure = direct invoice for first 90 days then switch to marketplace if available.
- Pilot needs expedited activation — can you confirm the 3-business-day expedited slot and any fee?

Also: who should receive the PO when ready? Our AP team usually emails POs to a single inbox.

Thanks,
Kate
Attachment: W-9_CirrusLabs.pdf, product_skus.csv
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Kate Miller <procurement@cirruslabs.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CirrusLabs marketplace onboarding & PO questions

Hi Kate — welcome, and thanks for the quick turnaround. A few operational notes from finance/enablement:

- PO destination: please send signed POs to ap@redwood.ai. Include the CirrusLabs legal name and Redwood PO contact in the body.
- Use the attached PO_template_Redwood.xlsx to map each SKU to our accounting tag; this avoids manual mapping delays.
- Billing terms: Net-30 is standard for enterprise customers. For marketplace charges (AWS) there is no Net-30; charges bill through the marketplace provider.
- Expedited onboarding: we can reserve an expedited slot if you complete paperwork and the PO template today. No fee — we prioritize marketplace go-lives for pilots under partner programs.

I'll coordinate the billing alias for GCP once the PO shows the billing alias field filled. Vanessa — can you confirm marketplace listing ETA if we get docs by EOD?

Regards,
Ben Carter
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: PO_template_Redwood.xlsx (xlsx)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Kate Miller <procurement@cirruslabs.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CirrusLabs marketplace onboarding & PO questions

Thanks all — sounds good and glad expedited activation is available. Final next steps to close this out (action items):

- CirrusLabs (Kate): upload signed W-9 and completed PO_template_Redwood.xlsx to the vendor portal link below and email the completed PO to ap@redwood.ai with subject line: "PO: CirrusLabs - Redwood Marketplace Pilot".
- Ben: confirm billing alias for GCP and confirm Net-30 terms on the PO when received.
- Vanessa: once paperwork is in portal, please kick off the listing workflow and aim for the expedited 3-business-day turnaround.

DocuSign packet: https://docusign.com/packet/abc123-cirrus-onboard
Vendor portal (private): https://vendor.redwood.ai/portal/CirrusLabs

I'll track this in our internal intake; expect an onboarding confirmation email once the paperwork is processed. If you want to hop on a 20-minute call to walk the AP team through the PO template, I'm available this afternoon.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
